The return process is straightforward! Here's how it works:
Step 1: Initiate the return
After the 30-day adjustment period, you can start your return by emailing support@avocadomattress.com with your order number.
Step 2: Troubleshooting
The Returns Team will ask a few questions and share tips to help you get the most out of your mattress — they've heard it all and want to make sure you've given it a fair shot.
Step 3: Submit photos
You'll need to provide photos of the mattress surface (free of linens) and the law tag to confirm it's in donation-worthy condition. Avocado donates all returned mattresses to one of their 1,500 nationwide nonprofit partners — they have a 95% donation success rate.

Once approved, Avocado coordinates the donation pickup from your address. You'll receive a full refund minus the $99 return fee.
